name: Search
reference: REQ-001; Apple reference adaptation; complete parity unverified
acceptance: Rynx KMP uses Apple iTunes song search with real Apple cover URLs; empty/error results fall back to InnerTubeX YouTube Music metadata and thumbnails. Conservative recording matching precedes stream resolution. Deterministic tests and local Android build pass; one Apple metadata/image request passed. YouTube live playback, visual parity, artwork usage rights and other platforms remain unverified.
tests: Apple and InnerTubeX provider tests pass; the Android debug/release/instrumentation APKs build. Live Apple search returned a 1200x1200 cover whose JPEG fetched successfully. No current device rendering or YouTube playback result.
